ex.en: How do you clean oil stains off clothes?
ex.zh: 衣服沾到油漬要怎麼洗？

ex.en: Do you have anything to remove stains?
ex.zh: 你有去汙漬的東西嗎？

ex.en: His shirt was stained with sauce.
ex.zh: 他的襯衫沾到了醬汁。

ex.en: A drop of mustard fell and stained my tie during lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐時一滴芥末醬掉下來，弄髒了我的領帶。

ex.en: Engineers found structural damage after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 工程師在地震後發現結構損壞。

ex.en: The company is going through structural changes.
ex.zh: 公司正在進行結構性變革。

ex.en: It is a stereotype that police officers always eat doughnuts.
ex.zh: 警察總是吃甜甜圈是一種刻板印象。

ex.en: This film attempts to break stereotypes and redefine what true masculinity is.
ex.zh: 這部電影試圖打破刻板印象，重新定義真正的男子氣概。

ex.en: Don't stereotype people based on their age.
ex.zh: 不要因為年齡就對人有刻板印象。

ex.en: Older workers are often stereotyped as slow with technology.
ex.zh: 年長員工常被貼上不擅長科技的標籤。

ex.en: Because of the blizzard, Tom and Mary were stranded in Boston.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雪，湯姆和瑪麗被困在波士頓。

ex.en: Hundreds of passengers were stranded at the airport.
ex.zh: 數百名旅客滯留在機場。

ex.en: A strand of hair fell across her face.
ex.zh: 一縷頭髮垂到她臉上。

ex.en: DNA consists of two strands.
ex.zh: DNA 由兩股鏈組成。

ex.en: The steward brought us blankets during the flight.
ex.zh: 飛行途中，空服員為我們送上毯子。

ex.en: Ask the steward if you need anything.
ex.zh: 需要什麼的話請詢問服務員。

ex.en: We are stewards of the company's resources.
ex.zh: 我們是公司資源的管理者。

ex.en: The steward managed the estate for the family.
ex.zh: 那位管家為這個家族管理莊園。

ex.en: I was stung by a bee.
ex.zh: 我被蜜蜂螫了一下。

ex.en: I've just been stung by a bee.
ex.zh: 我剛剛被蜜蜂螫了。

ex.en: The smoke made my eyes sting.
ex.zh: 煙讓我的眼睛刺痛。

ex.en: I got a bee sting.
ex.zh: 我被蜜蜂螫了一下。

ex.en: Bee stings can be very painful.
ex.zh: 被蜜蜂螫到可能非常痛。

ex.en: She put some cream on the sting.
ex.zh: 她在螫傷處擦了些藥膏。

stopover.zh: （旅途中的）短暫停留、中途停留

ex.en: We had a stopover in Chicago.
ex.zh: 我們中途在芝加哥停留了一下。

ex.en: Our flight to London has a stopover in Dubai.
ex.zh: 我們飛倫敦的班機會在杜拜中途停留。

ex.en: We decided to enjoy a two-day stopover in Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我們決定在東京停留兩天。

ex.en: English people rarely talk to strangers on trains.
ex.zh: 英國人在火車上很少和陌生人說話。

ex.en: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
ex.zh: 我跟陌生人在一起時很不自在。

ex.en: He treats me as if I am a stranger.
ex.zh: 他把我當成陌生人來看待。

ex.en: She gets along well with her stepmother.
ex.zh: 她和繼母相處得很好。

ex.en: In the story, Cinderella lives with her cruel stepmother.
ex.zh: 故事裡，灰姑娘跟她殘忍的繼母住在一起。

ex.en: There has been a lot of stress at work lately.
ex.zh: 最近工作壓力很大。

ex.en: She is unable to cope with stress.
ex.zh: 她無法應付壓力。

ex.en: I'm always stressed out.
ex.zh: 我總是壓力很大。

ex.en: She's stressed about her exams.
ex.zh: 她為了考試壓力很大。

ex.en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.
ex.zh: 他強調都市生活的便利。

ex.en: The teacher stressed the importance of practice.
ex.zh: 老師強調練習的重要性。

ex.en: Where do you place the stress in the word "Australia"?
ex.zh: 「Australia」這個字的重音在哪裡？

ex.en: The stress is on the second syllable.
ex.zh: 重音在第二個音節。

ex.en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.
ex.zh: 我爸媽說，YouTube 和串流平台讓電影失去了魔力。

ex.en: I watch most shows on streaming services now.
ex.zh: 我現在大多用串流平台看節目。

ex.en: Avoid sudden movements around the rabbit, they can startle them.
ex.zh: 避免在兔子旁邊突然做出動作，以免嚇到牠們。

ex.en: This startled me.
ex.zh: 這驚到我了。

ex.en: The sudden noise startled the baby.
ex.zh: 突然的聲響嚇到了嬰兒。

ex.en: The teacher gave his pupils a stern telling-off.
ex.zh: 老師把學生狠狠地罵了一頓。

ex.en: The teacher gave the noisy class a stern look.
ex.zh: 老師對吵鬧的班級投以嚴厲的眼神。

ex.en: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 我從來沒碰到過這麼倔的人。

ex.en: Why are you being so stubborn?
ex.zh: 你為什麼這麼倔？

ex.en: He is a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 他是個倔強的人。

ex.en: The drunk man staggered down the street.
ex.zh: 醉漢搖搖晃晃地走在街上。

ex.en: She staggered under the weight of the heavy bag.
ex.zh: 她被沉重的袋子壓得步履蹣跚。

ex.en: The beggar is collecting stale bread.
ex.zh: 這名乞丐在收集乾麵包。

ex.en: The beer is stale.
ex.zh: 啤酒沒氣了。

ex.en: The bread was stale after a week in the cupboard.
ex.zh: 麵包在櫥櫃裡放了一週後就不新鮮了。

ex.en: He is very stingy with his money.
ex.zh: 他非常吝嗇。

ex.en: Tom is stingy.
ex.zh: 湯姆很小氣。

ex.en: Mary doesn't like men who are stingy like Tom.
ex.zh: 瑪莉不喜歡跟湯姆一樣吝嗇的男人。

streak.zh: 一系列、一連串（的好運或壞運）

ex.en: The team is on a five-game winning streak.
ex.zh: 這支球隊正處於五連勝。

ex.en: He is having a streak of bad luck.
ex.zh: 他最近一直走霉運。

ex.en: Her hair is streaked with gray.
ex.zh: 她的頭髮中夾有白髮。

ex.en: Tears streaked her face.
ex.zh: 淚水在她臉上留下一道道痕跡。

ex.en: Wages have remained stagnant for several years.
ex.zh: 薪資已經停滯了好幾年。

ex.en: The stagnant economy made it hard to find a job.
ex.zh: 經濟不景氣讓人很難找到工作。

ex.en: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water.
ex.zh: 蚊子會在不流動的積水中繁殖。

ex.en: Open the window; the air in here is stagnant.
ex.zh: 開個窗吧，這裡的空氣都不流通。

ex.en: Although he is small in stature, he is a strong basketball player.
ex.zh: 雖然他個子不高，卻是個很強的籃球員。

ex.en: She was a woman of average stature with short dark hair.
ex.zh: 她是個身高中等、留著黑色短髮的女人。

ex.en: The scientist's stature grew after she won the international award.
ex.zh: 這位科學家獲得國際大獎後，聲望更高了。

ex.en: Few politicians have the stature to unite the whole country.
ex.zh: 很少有政治人物有足夠的威望來團結全國。

ex.en: She treats her stepchild just like her own daughter.
ex.zh: 她對待繼女就像對待自己的女兒一樣。

ex.en: Being a good stepparent takes time, and every stepchild needs patience.
ex.zh: 要當好繼父母需要時間，每個繼子女都需要耐心對待。

ex.en: The statute was passed in 1990.
ex.zh: 這項法令於 1990 年通過。

ex.en: Under the statute, companies must report their emissions.
ex.zh: 根據法規，企業必須申報排放量。

ex.en: Stagflation is a mix of high inflation and slow growth.
ex.zh: 停滯性通膨是高通膨加上經濟成長緩慢。

ex.en: Economists warn of possible stagflation next year.
ex.zh: 經濟學家警告明年可能出現停滯性通膨。

ex.en: We tried to come up to the standard.
ex.zh: 我們努力達到標準。

ex.en: This school sets high moral standards for pupils.
ex.zh: 這個學校對學生的道德標準要求很高。

ex.en: However, other aspects have already surpassed the standards of many Western countries.
ex.zh: 不過，其他方面已經超越了許多西方國家的水準。

ex.en: I would like to learn standard English.
ex.zh: 我想學標準的英語。

ex.en: Standard Chinese, commonly referred to as Mandarin, is based on Pekinese.
ex.zh: 標準中文，也就是一般所說的普通話，是以北京話為基礎。

ex.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
ex.zh: 我開始懷疑他陳述的準確性。

ex.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.
ex.zh: 我想撤回我之前的說法。

ex.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
ex.zh: 家屬對軍方的說法高度懷疑。

ex.en: I get a bank statement every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月會收到銀行對帳單。

ex.en: Check your credit card statement for errors.
ex.zh: 檢查一下信用卡帳單有沒有錯。

ex.en: He invested his money in stocks.
ex.zh: 他把錢投資在股票上。

ex.en: He lost a fortune in the stock market.
ex.zh: 他在股市賠了一大筆錢。

ex.en: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.
ex.zh: 這家公司在巴黎證券交易所上市。

ex.en: We have plenty of stock in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 倉庫裡存貨充足。

ex.en: That model is no longer in stock.
ex.zh: 那個型號已經沒有庫存了。

ex.en: The store stocks a wide range of organic food.
ex.zh: 這家店有賣各式各樣的有機食品。

ex.en: We need to stock up on water before the typhoon.
ex.zh: 颱風來之前我們需要多囤點水。

ex.en: Please store the files in the storage cabinet.
ex.zh: 請把檔案收進收納櫃。

ex.en: The storage cabinet is beside the printer.
ex.zh: 收納櫃就在印表機旁邊。

ex.en: From the supplier’s standpoint, the revised schedule is difficult to meet.
ex.zh: 從供應商的角度來看，修訂後的時程很難配合。

ex.en: The report considers the safety issue from both the workers’ and managers’ standpoints.
ex.zh: 這份報告從員工與主管雙方的角度探討安全問題。

ex.en: Interns receive a monthly stipend for transportation.
ex.zh: 實習生每月可領取交通津貼。

ex.en: The research stipend covers basic living costs.
ex.zh: 研究津貼可支付基本生活費。

ex.en: The manufacturer stockpiled essential components before the supplier’s factory closed for the holiday.
ex.zh: 供應商工廠假期停工前，製造商先儲備了必要零件。

ex.en: Hospitals were asked not to stockpile protective equipment beyond their needs.
ex.zh: 醫院接獲通知，不要囤積超出需求的防護設備。

ex.en: The shop closed for half a day while staff completed the annual stocktaking.
ex.zh: 店員進行年度盤點，店面因此暫停營業半天。

ex.en: Stocktaking revealed that several high-value items were missing.
ex.zh: 盤點結果顯示有幾件高價商品短少。

ex.en: The extra supplies are kept in the stockroom.
ex.zh: 多出的用品都放在庫房裡。

ex.en: Please check the stockroom before ordering more boxes.
ex.zh: 再訂紙箱之前，請先檢查庫房。

ex.en: A narrow staircase leads to the apartment"s attic.
ex.zh: 一座狹窄的樓梯通往公寓閣樓。

ex.en: The hotel installed a handrail along the marble staircase.
ex.zh: 飯店沿著大理石樓梯加裝扶手。

ex.en: The bakery renovated its storefront to attract more pedestrians.
ex.zh: 麵包店翻新店面，吸引更多路人。

ex.en: A vacant storefront is available for lease on the corner.
ex.zh: 轉角有一間空店面正在出租。

ex.en: National rescue teams are on standby ready to fly to Japan.
ex.zh: 各國救難隊都在待命，隨時準備飛往日本。

ex.en: The hospital keeps a generator on standby in case of a power outage.
ex.zh: 醫院準備了一台備用發電機，以防停電。

ex.en: We're on standby for the next flight to Seoul.
ex.zh: 我們在候補下一班飛往首爾的班機。

ex.en: Standby passengers can board only if there are empty seats.
ex.zh: 候補旅客只有在還有空位時才能登機。

ex.en: Go straight on to the end of the road.
ex.zh: 一直直走到這條路的盡頭。

ex.en: Go straight for two blocks.
ex.zh: 直走兩個街區。

ex.en: He drew a straight line on the wall.
ex.zh: 他在牆上畫了一條直線。

ex.en: Tom drew a straight line on the paper.
ex.zh: 湯姆在紙上畫了一道直線。

ex.en: He was ill in bed for four days straight.
ex.zh: 他一連四天臥病在床。

ex.en: It rained for three days straight.
ex.zh: 連續下了三天雨。

ex.en: You may stay here as long as you like.
ex.zh: 你想在這兒待多久就待多久。

ex.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
ex.zh: 比起出門，我更喜歡待在家。

ex.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the station.
ex.zh: 我們住在車站附近的一間小旅館。

ex.en: How long will you be staying in Japan?
ex.zh: 你會在日本待多久？

ex.en: Enjoy your stay!
ex.zh: 祝您住宿愉快！

ex.en: During my stay in London, I visited many museums.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦停留期間參觀了很多博物館。

ex.en: I thoroughly regretted staying up so late, come morning.
ex.zh: 到了早上，我非常後悔昨晚熬夜到那麼晚。

ex.en: I stayed up all night finishing my report.
ex.zh: 我熬了一整夜把報告寫完。

stolen.zh: 被偷的（steal 的過去分詞）

ex.en: I had my wallet stolen on the bus.
ex.zh: 我的錢包在公車上被偷了。

ex.en: He had his car stolen in broad daylight.
ex.zh: 他的車在光天化日之下被偷走了。

ex.en: Our stuff got stolen, and we missed our train.
ex.zh: 我們的東西被偷走了，而且我們錯過了火車。

ex.en: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
ex.zh: 他們很明顯在嫉妒他的財富和地位。

ex.en: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.
ex.zh: 我相信良好的教育能改變人的社會地位。

ex.en: Can you tell me about your marital status?
ex.zh: 能告訴我你的婚姻狀況嗎？

ex.en: What's the status of my order?
ex.zh: 我的訂單現在是什麼狀態？

ex.en: The new system will streamline our ordering process.
ex.zh: 新系統能簡化我們的訂購流程。

ex.en: We streamlined the application form to just one page.
ex.zh: 我們把申請表簡化到只有一頁。

ex.en: We should get feedback from all stakeholders.
ex.zh: 我們應該聽取所有利害關係人的意見。

ex.en: Customers and employees are key stakeholders.
ex.zh: 顧客和員工都是重要的利害關係人。

ex.en: What is your stance on remote work?
ex.zh: 你對遠距工作的立場是什麼？

ex.en: The company took a firm stance against discrimination.
ex.zh: 公司對歧視採取堅決反對的立場。

ex.en: The contract stipulates that payment must be made within 30 days.
ex.zh: 合約規定必須在 30 天內付款。

ex.en: The rules stipulate a maximum of two bags per person.
ex.zh: 規定每人最多兩件行李。

ex.en: Our staff will contact you in three working days.
ex.zh: 我們的工作人員會在三個工作日內聯絡您。

ex.en: The staff in that restaurant gave us a very good impression.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的服務人員給我們留下很好的印象。

ex.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
ex.zh: 整個業務團隊連續一週日夜加班。

ex.en: All of this stationery is his.
ex.zh: 這些都是他的文具。

ex.en: What stationery isn't worth buying?
ex.zh: 哪些文具不值得買？

ex.en: Because your business can play to my strengths.
ex.zh: 因為貴公司的業務能發揮我的長處。

ex.en: To remain competitive, we've got to play to our strengths.
ex.zh: 為了保持競爭力，我們得發揮我們的優勢。

ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.
ex.zh: 我沒力氣繼續嘗試了。

ex.en: He didn't have the strength to lift the box.
ex.zh: 他沒有力氣抬起那個箱子。
